description: Switches between views that share one place on the screen, such as Description · Facilities · Reviews. Two styles: a white pill on a grey track, or a green underline.
tip: Use Tabs for equal pieces of content read one at a time. To move between pages, use links or a Navigation Menu.

line.title: Underline
line.description: variant="line" on TabsList: the active tab gets a green line. Good for order lists or status filters.

icons.title: With icons & disabled
icons.description: Put the icon before the text. A tab with the disabled prop cannot be selected.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: orientation="vertical" stacks the tabs top to bottom, e.g. for a settings page.

parts.list: Row of tab buttons. The variant prop sets its look.
parts.trigger: One tab button; its value must match its TabsContent.
parts.content: Content shown while its tab is active.

props.defaultValue: Tab that is active at first (uncontrolled).
props.orientation: Direction of the tabs. Left/right or up/down arrows move between tabs.
props.variant: Look of the tab list: pill on a grey track, or underline.
